# BoardUI source and license

- BoardUI theme and typography foundations copied from https://github.com/BoardUI/boardui at commit `3e76e282614b147a34b9b2a510e31b97d58a3909`, under MIT (full license below). Source files: `packages/ui/src/styles/boardui-theme.css`, `packages/ui/src/styles/boardui-typography.css`. Application chat components are original; no BoardUI Pro template is included. Tailwind CSS v4 processes the upstream design tokens.

- BoardUI's component sources (Button, IconButton, Input, Textarea, Checkbox, Switch, Chip, Tabs, Notification, Select and the rest) were copied on 2026-09-09 and 2026-09-11 and replaced on 2026-10-17 by shadcn/ui components on Base UI (`packages/ui/SHADCN-NOTICE.md`). No Pro source was downloaded.

- Veynode Soft (2026-09-29) restyled the theme and typography files in place: they carry Veynode Soft's tokens in BoardUI's structure.
